name: Oribe Makoto
source:
A young man from a tribe who hold the special power of Kotodama. He is naturally curious about everything and a bit lacking in common sense, but at heart he's kind and pleasant person. Since he grew up providing for himself, he's well-versed in how to keep a household running.


Special skills: Cooking, gathering edible plants
Hobbies: Shopping at convenience stores
Likes: Convenience stores, TV, people's smiling faces
Dislikes: Noise, ill-intentioned people, people being in trouble

[Based on translation from the [url=http://www.purplesoftware.jp/products/amatsutsumi/#prettyPhoto]Developer's Site[/url]]
